description: A representation of a gwent card

id.description: The RFID tag ID that this card has been written to. Can be used to prevent accidental overwriting

image.description: URL for image of the card

range.description: Determines which row(s) the card applies to. Cards with agile ability can have more than one range and are placed in a row upon playing. The row chosen cannot change after placing.

strength.description: How many points this character carries

starter.description: Whether this card is a member the starter deck

instructions.description: Instructions to be shown on screen when this leader is played

weather.description: If this leader enables a weather card to be played from the deck, this indicates what kind of weather it is

specialty.description: Determines if a special ability is applied from this card. If the specialty is weather the range determines if it's frost, fog or rain. The scorch specialty applies to the entire board (which is also indicated by it having all ranges), as opposed to the scorch ability which applies only to the opponent's row of the same single range. Similarly the commander specialty means the card can be applied to any single row (indicated by the ranges it posseses) as opposed to the commander ability which only applies to a single row

transforms_to.description: Name of the card that a berserker transforms to
